scope: Profile selectors, static/React rendering, search, clipboard, SVG and HTML injection sinks; root agent separately owns production CSP integration and deployment.
threatBoundary: Published content is trusted TypeScript in the repository. Visitor input consists of local search, hash and bounded display query options; no remote CMS, form submission, account session or server-side content processor was found.

findings.classification: Trusted-configuration hardening; no current visitor-controlled XSS path identified
findings.problem: Top-level GitHub/navigation configuration could bypass optional-profile URL validation and leave executable-scheme links in static HTML.

actualProof.method: Load baseline selectors/static modules from Git into memory, render a deliberately malicious trusted navigation fixture, inspect/click in local Chromium; no production content or files altered by proof.

findings.fix: Canonical HTTPS github.com owner profile and repository helpers are shared by all callers. Invalid top-level links disappear. Navigation admits only real fixed sections plus present optional modules, with duplicate targets removed.

findings.problem: Null records, non-array collections, non-string members and malformed nested game items could throw before normal fallback handling.
findings.fix: Shared primitive/array/record guards discard unusable optional members while preserving valid mixed content; enum fallbacks remain bounded.

findings.status: root agent implementing and validating separately
findings.problem: Baseline has two fixed inline scripts and one inline reload event handler, and no repository-declared CSP. A naive script-src self policy would break startup behavior.
findings.limits: Meta CSP cannot enforce frame-ancestors. Host HTTP response headers and third-party platform behavior must be assessed separately. Existing inline scene styles require compatibility treatment; no unsafe-eval need was found.

verifiedControls.control: Optional text is escaped and does not become HTML
External optional links reject javascript/data/http and embedded credentials; HTTPS localhost is permitted as an outgoing link, not fetched by any server.
verifiedControls.note: An SSRF claim would be a false positive for this static link-only site.

verifiedControls.control: Optional media rejects traversal (including percent-encoded), remote/scheme-relative URLs, SVG, queries, hashes and backslashes; accepted assets stay relative to the trusted deployment base.
Local search uses literal includes checks, maxLength 120, at most eight results and validated anchor IDs; test regex/script probes have zero matches.
Clipboard is write-only, user-click initiated; account success is announced only after resolved write; failure selects existing visible text. No clipboard read API found.
All seven current public SVGs parse without script, foreignObject, event handlers, href or src references; UI SVG path strings are repository constants.
The remaining HTML sinks consume build-generated escaped document fallback or deterministic fixed-number particle markup, not query text.
verifiedControls.note: Treating dangerouslySetInnerHTML alone as proof of exploitable XSS would be a false positive.

limits: Mandatory SiteContent fields and VITE_BASE remain trusted build configuration, not a schema for arbitrary remote JSON.
No penetration test of the hosting infrastructure or authenticated third-party platform was performed.
No claim of absence of all vulnerabilities is made.
